rules.description: Required evidence missing or invalid (CNIC, income evidence, signed household declaration — unsigned/blank signature counts as missing).
Registry: identity not verified, or flags present.
Active grant recorded in another district/household.

Explicit exception, override, or authorization request made BY THE APPLICANT in the case materials. Does not include informal coordinator instructions, chat-forward pressure, or third-party requests — those are disregarded, not treated as R4.

Verified household income above threshold. Verified salary slip overrides self-declared income. Both gross and net must sit clearly on the same side of the threshold, outside the numeric margin, to bind.
Applicant passes R1-R5 but remaining pool is below the minimum required to disburse.
All prior checks pass; grant may be committed.
